name: Zinnkrug
kurzbeschreibung: Restaurant Zinnkrug in the heart of Kitzbühel: home-style cooking, pizza, fish specialties, terrace and beer garden. Open daily 11:00–23:00.
beschreibung:
The Restaurant Zinnkrug is located at Graggaugasse 4 in the historic center of Kitzbühel, near the Stadtpfarrkirche. The non-smoking venue seats around 120 guests, plus a bar, a beer garden and a terrace. Dogs are welcome in the restaurant.

The menu covers both local and international cuisine equally: classics like the house Gröstl with cabbage salad, pizza and pasta, fish specialties as well as fondue Swiss style.

Open daily from 11:00 to 23:00, hot food served all day. Table reservations are accepted by phone only. The Tyrol Chamber of Commerce lists the business as a sole proprietorship in the gastronomy sector.
